meaning: For the same motion, the header stamps of the lidar frames are this much later than the wheel/IMU odometry. Positive means the lidar is late.
how_to_apply: Pair each lidar frame with the wheel/IMU odometry at stamp - lidar_time_offset_ms, i.e. stamp the scan earlier by the offset. Interpolate the odometry linearly in x, y and unwrapped yaw; hold the end poses. Same arithmetic as wc_navigation.live.amcl_cross.shifted_odometry (window D) and wc_navigation.autonomy.replay_mapping.shifted_poses.

defaults.live_chain: use lidar_time_offset_ms from this file (user decision 2026-11-08 11:30), including the 3D obstacle input
defaults.offline_replay_and_evaluation: 0 unless --lidar-time-offset-ms is given explicitly; results built or evaluated with 75 ms must say so

applies_to.time_basis: host arrival stamps of the lidar frames and of the IMU/wheel samples

estimates_ms.method: lidar ICP yaw rate against gyro z (bias removed), cross-correlation over -100..+200 ms in 1 ms steps; uncertainty is the standard deviation of a 20-block bootstrap
